name: Blissmade Furniture Co.
old_description: Inspired by the construction of early American timber frames and cabins. The simplicity and durability of the traditional joinery in this collection is a defining feature of the aesthetic.
about:
Blissmade Furniture Co. operates from Dunbarton, New Hampshire, where it designs and builds heirloom furniture and cabinetry. The company focuses on premium native hardwoods and traditional joinery techniques inspired by early American timber frames and cabins.

The product line spans six distinct collections—Bay Point, Early American, Galehead, Studio Craft, Lakehouse, and Shaker Harvest—each drawing on historical American furniture styles. In addition to case goods, the company reproduces solid brass hardware using traditional patterns. Production relies on hand-fitted joinery and solid-wood construction rather than veneers or particle board.

Blissmade serves residential clients, interior designers, and architects seeking historically accurate pieces for period homes and new builds. The collections are marketed as heirloom-grade furnishings built to withstand seasonal changes and generations of use.

The company emphasizes the simplicity and durability of traditional joinery as its defining aesthetic, positioning each piece as a modern continuation of early American craft traditions.
